hooks.text: 跨物种繁育随机继承能力，再用器官、符文和炼金定向改造
hooks.excerpt: Crossbred offspring inherit their parents’ physical characteristics and special abilities at random. Their valuable traits can be enhanced with special feed, potions, blood infusions, rune stones, magic scrolls and organ implantation.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 过度强化会患畸变病，缩短寿命并暂时失去参赛资格
hooks.excerpt: However, excessive intervention can lead to abomination illness, reducing the creature’s lifespan and rendering it temporarily unfit for combat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 经营繁育场还要管工匠、建筑和高息贷款破产风险
hooks.excerpt: You can hire a blacksmith or an alchemist, so you're not limited to the offerings of local merchants and annual fairs. You can expand your base by constructing new buildings or upgrading existing ones. If you run into financial trouble, you can take out a loan—but the high interest rates could drive you into bankruptcy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 素材商店式的通用视觉让制作价值显得很低。

excerpts.excerpt: The production value is ultra low. It's almost all generic Unity work with assets from the Unity assets store
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 整体美术方向被批评为丑陋、像早期三维游戏。

excerpts.excerpt: Ugly/bad art direction. This is a great example of art direction vs graphic fidelity. Everything looks ugly. Like, early 2000 3D ugly.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗日志和胜利界面的字体配色脱离主题。

excerpts.excerpt: the battle logs and the victory overview makes use of very -out of theme- fonts and colors.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 成长节奏始终缓慢，过程像持续刷取

excerpts.excerpt: But actually it never goes fast enough and it's always a slow grind.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 竞技场战斗在短时间内就呈现重复的单一打法。

excerpts.excerpt: In the 2 hours I played, every battle played out the same. Let enemy come to you and take out 1 at a time as best you can.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高命中率仍频繁落空，战斗表现被认为失衡且随机。

excerpts.excerpt: I did not see any difference in hitting anything with 7 % change or with 97% change. I always had more misses, but even that much hits with the 7% change. It feels very unbalanced
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期操作需要数百次点击，体验像在工作

excerpts.excerpt: Ends up in hundred clicks easily. Feels like work.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 教程严重不足，关键系统缺少清楚说明。

excerpts.excerpt: Tutorial is seriously lacking in this game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗长期仍然糟糕到足以毁掉整体体验。

excerpts.excerpt: combat is still so fking awful to do it ruins the game for me
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 怪物捕捉、繁育和培养系统具有很深的策略层次。

excerpts.excerpt: Offers a lot of depth, with complex monster capturing, breeding and raising mechanics.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
